name: gamut
description: Gamut Repair — repair and quality tracking for the factory

scripts.dev: echo "Run in two terminals: npm run dev:server  and  npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @gamut/core && npm run test -w @gamut/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gamut/core && npm run typecheck -w @gamut/server && npm run typecheck -w @gamut/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run check-i18n -w @gamut/web && npm test && npm run build
